name: Typeform
whatYouLose: Advanced respondent analytics and drop-off reporting
A huge template and integration marketplace
prompt: Create a conversational form builder with one question per screen, conditional branching, keyboard navigation, themes, custom thank-you screens, share links, webhook delivery, CSV export, email notifications, response limits, and a results dashboard. Use Astro SSR, vanilla JavaScript and SQLite. Provide a drag-free schema editor that stores forms as JSON, validates all inputs server-side, supports accessible controls, and includes anti-spam honeypots and rate limits.
notes: For lead capture, onboarding and surveys, the core product is surprisingly small. Sophisticated analytics and governance are the expensive edge.
